_comment: SPARK — S165 P5: the TWELVE per-race ZONE BACKGROUNDS (owner ruling R137).
⛔ TWELVE, NOT SIX, AND THE REASON IS GEOMETRIC RATHER THAN COSMETIC. Owner R137: *"we would
need to generate 2 backgrounds for each race (one for the 2 player map and one for the 4 player
map). they should be very similar but still a tad different"*. Measured against src/state/zones.ts:
SPLIT_X = CANVAS_WIDTH/2 = 960 and SPLIT_Y = CANVAS_HEIGHT/2 = 540, so
· PITCH_2P splits on ONE VERTICAL line  -> a zone is 960 x 1080, PORTRAIT (8:9)
· QUADRANTS_4P splits on a CROSS        -> a zone is 960 x  540, LANDSCAPE (16:9)
One image cannot serve both: stretched it distorts, letterboxed it leaves dead ground, cropped it
loses the composition. AND the castle anchor sits differently — 2P keeps are in the GOALMOUTHS at
mid-height against the touchline, 4P keeps are in the OUTER CORNERS — so the focal point belongs
in a different part of the frame on each board.
⭐ GENERATION IS ORDERED, AND THE ORDER IS THE POINT (R137's own method). Every `-4p` LANDSCAPE
is generated FIRST from its race banner; every `-2p` PORTRAIT is then seeded off its own `-4p`
via refImages. That is the same identity-anchoring that ties each race unit to its banner, and it
is what makes the pair SIBLINGS rather than cousins — which is exactly what "very similar but
still a tad different" asks for.
⛔ THESE ARE BACKDROPS, NOT ILLUSTRATIONS. The board is PURE BLACK today and every piece of
gameplay — towers, structures, connectors, creatures, sparks — is drawn ON TOP. The owner's
requirement is that the art be *"partially transparent so towers, structures, connectors and
creatures stay readable"*. Alpha is the RENDERER'S job (draw at reduced opacity, and the toggle
back to the black board is a render setting). What the ART must do is carry its own half of that
contract: DARK, LOW-CONTRAST, LOW-DETAIL, no bright passages, nothing that competes with a sprite.
A background that is beautiful on its own and unreadable under a battle has failed.
⚠ AND LESS COLOURFUL THAN THE BANNERS, DELIBERATELY. Owner: the banner art is the style reference
but *"a little more realistic"* and less colourful, *"with the seat colour surviving as accents"*.
So each prompt keeps its race's hue as ACCENT ONLY — a rim light, a glow, a stain — over a muted
near-monochrome ground.
⚠ VAMPIRES' SETTING WAS NEVER RULED (the brief's open Q1). Carpathian mountain night is taken
from assets-source/race-units/design-spec.json, where it is already this race's recorded setting,
so the choice is at least CONSISTENT with shipped art rather than invented here. It is MINE, not
the owner's, and it is flagged so he can overrule it cheaply.
⚠ ASPECT RATIOS ARE THE NEAREST THE MODEL OFFERS, NOT THE EXACT ZONE RATIO. 16:9 is exact for the
4P zone. The 2P zone is 8:9 (0.889) and the generator's portrait options do not include it, so 3:4
is used and the renderer covers-and-crops. Recorded because a later session measuring 3:4 against
960x1080 will otherwise read it as a bug.
sharedStyle: A DARK, MOODY, LOW-CONTRAST environment backdrop for a game board — a wide empty landscape with
no characters and no foreground clutter.
Painted in a stylised cartoon-illustration style with soft ink linework and flat shading, a little
more realistic and less saturated than a poster — muted, near-monochrome, atmospheric.
⛔ IT MUST STAY DARK AND QUIET. Overall value is deep and shadowed, like a scene lit only by
moonlight or distant embers. NO bright passages, no white or near-white areas, no strong
highlights, no hard focal point, no busy detail, nothing that would compete with brightly coloured
game pieces drawn on top of it. Think of it as a faded mural seen through darkness.
⛔ EMPTY MIDDLE GROUND. The centre of the frame must stay open, plain and uncluttered — structures
and terrain features belong around the EDGES of the frame. Nothing may occupy or draw the eye to
No characters, no people, no creatures, no animals, no vehicles.
No text, no lettering, no words, no logo, no border, no frame, no vignette, no UI, no map markers.
Fills the entire frame edge to edge with no margin and no letterboxing.

characters.name: zone-vampires-4p
characters._race: vampires — crimson 0xff3b6b — Carpathian mountain night (⚠ SETTING IS MINE, owner Q1 open)
characters.prompt: A Carpathian mountain valley at night, seen from a distance. Black jagged pine forest along the lower edges, steep bare crags rising at the far left and right, a thin cold mist lying in the hollow, a sliver of moon behind torn cloud. Everything is deep blue-black and charcoal. Faint CRIMSON accents only: a dull red glow in a handful of distant windows on a far crag, and a cold crimson rim light along the topmost cloud edge. The centre of the valley floor is open, empty and featureless.

characters.name: zone-nagas-4p
characters.prompt: A drowned military citadel on the deep sea floor, seen from a distance. Toppled basalt columns and the ribbed hull of a sunken war-galley along the lower edges, harsh angular fortress walls and a broken sea-god statue at the far left and right, silt drifting in slow currents, the water above almost black. Everything is deep teal-black and slate. Faint CYAN accents only: a cold cyan glow leaking from arrow-slits in the far walls and a thin cyan shimmer on the drifting silt. The centre of the sea floor is open, empty and featureless.

characters.name: zone-mummies-4p
characters.prompt: A moonlit desert necropolis, seen from a distance. Low dunes and half-buried sandstone blocks along the lower edges, a weathered step-pyramid silhouette at the far left and a colossal broken statue's legs at the far right, wind-blown sand hazing the air. Everything is deep umber-black and cold grey-brown. Faint AMBER-GOLD accents only: a dull gold glimmer on one distant carved lintel and a warm amber haze low on the horizon. The centre of the sand flat is open, empty and featureless.

characters.name: zone-zombies-4p
characters.prompt: A rotting swamp of ruined cottages at night, seen from a distance. Black still water and dead reeds along the lower edges, collapsed timber cottages and leaning gravestones at the far left and right, bare dead trees, a low clinging fog. Everything is deep bog-green-black and wet grey. Faint SICKLY GREEN accents only: a dull swamp-glow rising off the water in two or three patches and a faint green phosphorescence on the rotten timber. The centre of the water is open, empty and featureless.

characters.name: zone-orcs-4p
characters.prompt: A badlands war-camp at dusk, seen from a distance. Cracked red-brown hardpan and scattered bones along the lower edges, crude timber palisades, hide tents and a rough watchtower at the far left and right, mesa cliffs behind, dust hanging in the air. Everything is deep rust-black and dull brown. Faint BURNT-ORANGE accents only: two or three low banked cook-fires glowing dully behind the palisade and a thin orange band on the horizon. The centre of the hardpan is open, empty and featureless.

characters.name: zone-demons-4p
characters.prompt: An infernal wasteland, seen from a distance. Cracked black basalt and cooling lava fissures along the lower edges, jagged obsidian spires and a ruined bone-and-iron arch at the far left and right, ash falling slowly, a sky of black smoke. Everything is deep charcoal and volcanic near-black. Faint MAGENTA accents only: a violet-magenta glow deep inside the fissures and a magenta cast on the underside of the smoke. The centre of the basalt plain is open, empty and featureless.
